python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# FY 1945-1959 surplus/deficit values (in millions)
# From the treasury bulletins:
# 1945-1954 from 1954 bulletin (using new reporting basis for 1953-1954)
# 1955-1959 from 1960 bulletin

values = [
    -53941,  # 1945

    754,     # 1947

    -1811,   # 1949
    -3122,   # 1950
    3510,    # 1951
    -4017,   # 1952
    -9449,   # 1953 (new reporting basis)
    -3117,   # 1954
    -4180,   # 1955
    1626,    # 1956
    1596,    # 1957
    -2819,   # 1958
    -12427   # 1959
]

print("FY 1945-1959 Budget Surplus/Deficit (millions $):")
for i, v in enumerate(values):
    print(f"  {1945+i}: {v}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation
# Using n-1 denominator (sample standard deviation)
mean = statistics.mean(values)
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")

# Sample standard deviation (using n-1)
sample_std = statistics.stdev(values)
print(f"Sample Standard Deviation: {sample_std}")

# Round to nearest thousandths
sample_std_rounded = round(sample_std, 3)
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {sample_std_rounded}")
EOF
